verdict.rationale: Navan's Expense API documents retrieval and batch PATCH update of card transactions and manual expenses, plus company-field and custom-field management, so an agent can pull transactions and write coding back. The hosted MCP server is documented for querying spend and explaining why a transaction was flagged, not for writing changes, and API access is partner-gated. missing for 10: documented filter for uncoded transactions, a write path for coding or policy flags via MCP, a staged "push back for review" workflow, an agent-writable policy-flag field, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review

citations.quote: Retrieve and update Navan card transactions, Connect card transactions, manual expenses, payroll, repayments, fees, adjustments, daily rebates, and disputes — all from a single API.
